name: ihm-tms
description: IHM Southern Africa Travel Management System — Next.js web app, Express REST API on Cloud Functions, Firestore.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w functions" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w web
